subject: Urgent: maintenance window & temporary unpin request for private deployment
messages:
From: Kate Sullivan <kate.sullivan@greenlinehealth.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: maintenance window and unpin request for private deployment

Hi Sofia,

We're preparing for a regulatory audit and need to schedule a mandatory security patch on our Private (VPC) deployment running in our account. The external auditors require the latest kernels and a CVE mitigation that Redwoods' on-prem image includes, which is currently behind our pinned version.

Request: can Redwood temporarily unpin our fleet to allow the patch and then re-pin after a controlled verification period? Constraints from our side:
- Maximum planned disruption: 30 minutes of degraded performance per pool; total downtime must be minimized.
- We require a full audit-log export (token-level traces) for the maintenance window.
- The original pinned version must remain available (snapshot) for at least 72 hours in case we need to revert for compliance reasons.
- Preflight validation with our NOC and security team is required 24h before the window.

Candidate windows: May 14–15 (we prefer May 14, 02:00–04:00 UTC). Please advise if that is feasible and what the rollback options look like — specifically how a rollback would be performed and how long it would take to restore the prior pinned version.

I've attached our audit window spreadsheet. If you need additional SL/contacts for escalation, loop them in.

Thanks,
Kate Sullivan
Director, IT Operations
Greenline Health
Attachments: greenline_audit_window_2025.xlsx

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Kate Sullivan <kate.sullivan@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-08T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: maintenance window and unpin request for private deployment

Hi Kate — thanks for the heads up and the spreadsheet. We can support a temporary unpin for the May 14 window but want to be explicit about the steps, trade-offs, and safeguards so your audit requirements are satisfied and we can keep the risk tightly controlled. High-level plan below; I copied Laura/Platform Ops and Karthik for runbook/rollback specifics.

Proposed maintenance approach (summary):
1) Preflight (May 13, 12:00–14:00 UTC)
   - Dry-run in your staging environment with the same model binaries and quantization profile.
   - Smoke tests: connectivity, token-level logging, and latency baseline capture.
2) Canary unpin (May 14, 02:00 UTC)
   - Release to a small canary pool (5% of traffic; isolated tenant slice).
   - Monitor token latency, errors, and KV cache hit-rate for 20 minutes.
3) Gradual ramp (if canary passes)
   - 25% -> 50% -> full based on health gates; each step 15–20 minutes.
4) Post-upgrade verification
   - Keep previous pinned image snapshot for 72 hours (we will not delete snapshots during this retention window).
   - Export auditing traces and deliver the audit log bundle within 6 hours of window close.
5) Emergency rollback
   - Circuit-breaker trigger or manual rollback will switch traffic back to the snapshoted version. Expected recovery: 6–18 minutes to restore service to previous steady-state under normal conditions; worst-case (large KV-cache miss) could take up to 45 minutes for full warm-up.

Attachments: I've attached a concise maintenance plan and our rollback checklist for the Private deployment. Please review and confirm the May 14 02:00–04:00 UTC slot. Also confirm that Greenline's NOC can join a preflight call on May 13 at 12:30 UTC.

Notes/assumptions:
- We will disable auto-eviction policies for the pinned slice during the window.
- Quantization settings will remain the same as long as model artifacts are identical; any architecture-level change requires a longer window.

If this matches your needs we'll schedule the preflight and run a rehearsed rollback with our ops team beforehand.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_proposed_maintenance_plan.pdf, rollback-checklist.md

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kate Sullivan <kate.sullivan@greenlinehealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2025-05-09T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: maintenance window and unpin request for private deployment

Kate / Sofia — adding the ops-level details for the rollback and gating thresholds so Greenline's security team can verify them against audit requirements. Quoting Sofia's plan below.

Rollback mechanics (technical):
- Snapshot ID: we will create an immutable image of the pinned version (image-id: gl-20250508-pin-snap).
- Rollback command (control-plane): `redwoodctl private rollback --account greenline --snapshot gl-20250508-pin-snap --force`
- KV-caching: on rollback we will serve tokens from cold cache; recommend running a cache-warm job that replays top-1000 prefix requests (we will provide the script).
- Network: we will perform a short BGP prepend in the VPC bridge if we detect cross-region failover to reduce routing flaps.

Health gates (canary -> ramp):
- Error rate <= 0.5% (5xx + generation failures) over 5-minute window
- Median token latency delta < 20% vs baseline
- Token-level cost within 10% of baseline (for billing reconciliation)

Escalation contacts:
- Primary: Karthik Iyer (on-call) — +1 415 555 0189
- Secondary: Laura Bennett (Platform Ops Lead) — +1 650 555 0242
- Exec on-call (for SLA exceptions): Sofia Ivanova — +1 650 555 0123

Runbook & rehearsal: we propose a 30-minute rehearsal on May 13 with your NOC so we can time the worst-case recovery and verify log exports. I'll attach the cache-warm script and the control-plane rollback snippets to the runbook folder (JIRA-OPS-4721).

—Karthik

Thanks — that looks workable. Greenline approves the May 14, 02:00–04:00 UTC window for the unpin and patching, contingent on the following:
- We get the audit-log bundle within 6 hours of completion (as you noted).
- The original pinned image must be retained and accessible for 72 hours post-maintenance.
- We want the preflight rehearsal on May 13 at 12:30 UTC (Greenline NOC will join).

Please schedule the rehearsal and confirm who from Redwood will own the rollback command if it's triggered during the window. Also please send the cache-warm replay script and the control-plane command set ahead of the preflight — we will run them in our staging.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on this,
Kate

Greenline Health
